prompt: On the npm registry, what version of the package `chalk` is currently tagged `latest` (the `dist-tags.latest` value)? Reply with ONLY the version number.
note: Deliberately drift-prone: the answer changes whenever chalk publishes. The key is snapshotted once per comparison block, so both arms are graded against the same fetch.

argv: fetch('https://registry.npmjs.org/chalk').then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.json()}).then(j=>{const v=j['dist-tags']&&j['dist-tags'].latest;if(typeof v!=='string')throw new Error('no dist-tags.latest');console.log(v)})
